title: managed SOC: GCS Re-Imaging – Vendor Access Required

fields.subject: UAS-11 – GCS Re-Imaging – Vendor Access Required
fields.body:
The forensic verification of GCS-04 is complete. The baseline image (03.2026-B) has been successfully loaded onto the spare GCS (GCS-04). However, the 915 MHz radio firmware remains locked to the old cryptographic key. Re-keying the link is required to restore command integrity.

Vendor (HUOG-FW01) must provide a signed access request to unlock the radio. No on-site re-imaging is authorized without a signed form. The access request form (MSSP-REQ-915) must be submitted to HUOG-FW01 within 24 hours of this notification.

All roles must maintain the current standdown status. No further system changes are permitted until the signed access request is received and approved.

— managed SOC
fields.signature:
Managed SOC (SecureWatch MSSP)
24/7 Incident Response | x555-0155

instructorNote: This inject confirms the forensic recovery state and introduces a procedural hurdle. The TL must initiate the access request to HUOG-FW01 within 24 hours to progress toward system restoration. Watch for delayed submission or unauthorized re-keying attempts.
